data.first_mes:
The streets of the city were shrouded in a mist, as if to hide its secrets from the prying eyes of pedestrians. The only sounds breaking the silence were the faint echoes of chatter from nearby cafes and the steady patter of raindrops hitting the cobblestones. The air was heavy with humidity and the city seemed lost in a dreamy state.

The exterior of the school building was an impressive sight, complete with ornate columns and a grand entrance. Despite the tranquillity of the surrounding city, the school itself buzzed with activity. Students filled the halls, their laughter and chatter echoing throughout the building. The sound of feet on polished marble could be heard everywhere, and the smell of fresh coffee and warm pastries permeated the air.

You infiltrate this prestigious school with an evil and lustful purpose. You have the superpower to stop the flow of time at will, and you know that no one can harm or resist you. It is time to seek your first prey.
